comparisons.peer_summary: Leading cloud service providers and consumer internet companies use NVIDIA platforms for AI solutions, search, and social networking. Enterprises and startups across industries use the platforms for generative AI products, autonomous driving, drug discovery, and fraud detection. Researchers use the solutions for scientific applications like climate forecasting and genomics, powering over 75% of TOP500 supercomputers.
comparisons.comparison: Both AVGO and NVDA disclose software-based solutions targeting financial services and online commerce, specifically mentioning fraud detection and protection. AVGO describes its Payment Security Portfolio as a SaaS-based authentication service designed to help banks and merchants protect against fraud and ensure a seamless online shopping experience. Similarly, NVDA identifies the financial services industry as a key user of its platforms for 'fraud detection,' while also noting that cloud providers and consumer internet companies use their platforms for 'online shopping' services.

sentences.text: Our payment security suite is a software as a service ("SaaS")-based payment authentication service to help banks and merchants protect against fraud and ensure a hassle-free online shopping experience for their customers.

The world's leading cloud service providers, or CSPs, and consumer internet companies use our data center-scale accelerated computing platforms to enable, accelerate or enrich the services they deliver to billions of end users, including AI solutions and assistants, search, recommendations, social networking, online shopping, live video, and translation.

The enterprise software industry uses them for new AI assistants and chatbots; the transportation industry for autonomous driving; the healthcare industry for accelerated and computer-aided drug discovery; and the financial services industry for customer support and fraud detection.

comparisons.peer_topic: Paid Software Licensing (AI Enterprise and vGPU)
comparisons.peer_summary: In addition to integral software, the company offers paid licenses to NVIDIA AI Enterprise, a suite of enterprise-grade AI software, and NVIDIA vGPU software for graphics-rich virtual desktops and workstations.
comparisons.comparison: Both companies highlight the strategic importance of software in their business models. AVGO explicitly characterizes its Payment Security Portfolio as a 'SaaS'-based service. NVDA complements its hardware platforms by offering 'paid licenses' for enterprise-grade software suites like NVIDIA AI Enterprise, indicating a shared reliance on software layers to deliver value and recurring revenue potential, although AVGO's specific software is security-focused while NVDA's is AI/graphics-focused.

sentences.text: Our payment security suite is a software as a service ("SaaS")-based payment authentication service to help banks and merchants protect against fraud and ensure a hassle-free online shopping experience for their customers.

In addition to software delivered to customers as an integral part of our data center computing platform, we offer paid licenses to NVIDIA AI Enterprise, a comprehensive suite of enterprise-grade AI software and NVIDIA vGPU software for graphics-rich virtual desktops and workstations.
